targets.query:
from(bucket: "kafka_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FlowRates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic == "bl-fermi-01-dump.blinky-hub.blinky-mqtt.flowMeter-01.reading")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rate1_value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "Rate 1")
